Title: User submits valid name and phone number on User Details Form
Preconditions: Streamlit app is running (streamlit run ui/app.py) and sidebar navigation is visible
Steps: 1. Open the app in the browser | 2. In the sidebar, select "User Details Form" | 3. Enter a valid name in the Name field | 4. Enter a valid phone number in the Phone Number field | 5. Click the Submit button
Expected Result: A success message "Thank you, John Doe! Your details have been submitted." is displayed and no error messages are shown

Title: Navigate from Contact Us page to User Details Form and submit
Preconditions: Streamlit app is running and sidebar navigation is visible
Steps: 1. Open the app in the browser (defaults to Home) | 2. Select "Contact Us" in the sidebar and verify address, email, and phone details are shown | 3. Select "User Details Form" in the sidebar immediately after Contact Us | 4. Fill in Name and Phone Number fields | 5. Click Submit and confirm success message
Expected Result: User can move from Contact Us to User Details Form via sidebar, the form renders correctly, and submission succeeds with a confirmation message

Title: Phone number with allowed special characters and minimum length is accepted
Preconditions: Streamlit app is running and User Details Form page is open
Steps: 1. Navigate to "User Details Form" | 2. Enter a valid name | 3. Enter a phone number containing spaces and a hyphen at the minimum accepted length (7 characters) | 4. Click Submit
Expected Result: Phone number passes validation (matches 7-15 chars of digits, +, -, spaces) and the success message is displayed

Title: Whitespace-only input is trimmed and treated as empty for validation
Preconditions: Streamlit app is running and User Details Form page is open
Steps: 1. Navigate to "User Details Form" | 2. Enter a name consisting of leading/trailing spaces around valid text | 3. Enter a valid phone number | 4. Click Submit
Expected Result: Name is trimmed before display, submission succeeds, and the success message shows the trimmed name "Rahul"

Title: Submitting the form with both fields empty shows validation errors
Preconditions: Streamlit app is running and User Details Form page is open
Steps: 1. Navigate to "User Details Form" | 2. Leave the Name field empty | 3. Leave the Phone Number field empty | 4. Click Submit
Expected Result: Two error messages are displayed: "Name is required." and "Phone number is required.", and no success message appears

Title: Submitting an invalid phone number format shows a validation error
Preconditions: Streamlit app is running and User Details Form page is open
Steps: 1. Navigate to "User Details Form" | 2. Enter a valid name | 3. Enter a phone number containing letters or fewer than 7 / more than 15 characters | 4. Click Submit
Test Data: Name: Sam Lee; Phone Number: abc
Expected Result: An error message "Please enter a valid phone number." is displayed and no success message appears
